title: Apex Leak Alarm Repeat Offenders
dataSources: Apex controller readings (`apex:reading`), Seneye measurements (`seneye:reading`), reptile thermostat events (`reptilethermostat:event`), and misting-system cycles (`mister:cycle`).
app: Aquarium and terrarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, Seneye, reptile thermostats, and misting systems sent to Splunk HEC via controller APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=apex:reading
| stats count(eval(leak_alarm="true")) as leak_alarms count as samples by location_name
| sort 0 - leak_alarms
description: Ranks locationss by Apex leak alarms.
value: A repeat-offender list for leak alarms helps you fix the cabinet or plumbing spot that keeps flirting with disaster.
implementation: Send Apex leak alarms events to `index=personal` and keep `location_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of Apex leak alarms by locations.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which locationss stand out most for Apex leak alarms.
